## `pyrite filter`

```text
Usage: pyrite filter [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Manage reusable downstream filter presets, separate from placements.

Options:
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  attach           Append a named plate reference to PROFILE's ordered filter...
  create           Create or clone a validated named plate without placing it in a...

  detach           Replace a placement (name or one-based index) with equivalent...
  list             List named filter definitions in the selected catalog.
  rename           Rename a filter, updating all placements by reference.
  set              Update a user definition; future resolutions receive its new...
  show             Inspect one filter definition and its referencing profile...
  validate         Validate a named plate through the selected catalog without...
```

## `pyrite filter attach`

```text
Usage: pyrite filter attach [OPTIONS] PROFILE NAME

  Append a named plate reference to PROFILE's ordered filter sequence.

Options:
  --instance-name TEXT  Optional scene-local display name.
  --distance-mm FLOAT   Optional distance override in mm.
  --dry-run
  -h, --help            Show this message and exit.
```

## `pyrite filter create`

```text
Usage: pyrite filter create [OPTIONS] NAME

  Create or clone a validated named plate without placing it in a scene.

Options:
  --from TEXT                   Clone a named definition.
  --description TEXT            Optional display description.
  --material TEXT               Catalog crystal or medium key.
  --thickness-mm FLOAT          Plate thickness in mm.
  --size-mm <FLOAT FLOAT>...    Full width/height in mm.
  --distance-mm FLOAT           Default source-to-plate distance in mm.
  --polar-deg FLOAT             Polar angle in degrees.
  --azimuth-deg FLOAT           Azimuth angle in degrees.
  --roll-deg FLOAT              Roll in degrees.
  --offset-mm <FLOAT FLOAT>...  Local x/y offset in mm.
  --dry-run
  -h, --help                    Show this message and exit.
```

## `pyrite filter create-sequence`

```text
Usage: pyrite filter create-sequence [OPTIONS] NAME MEMBERS...

  Create an ordered sequence by copying single-plate presets MEMBERS.

  Members are copied, not referenced: later edits to them do not propagate. Order is
  beam order and each plate keeps its own absolute pose.

Options:
  --description TEXT  Optional display description.
  --dry-run           Print proposed TOML diff; write nothing.
  -h, --help          Show this message and exit.
```

## `pyrite filter delete`

```text
Usage: pyrite filter delete [OPTIONS] NAME

  Delete an unreferenced, user-owned definition; irreversible.

Options:
  -y, --yes   Delete the exact previewed definition.
  --dry-run
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.
```

## `pyrite filter detach`

```text
Usage: pyrite filter detach [OPTIONS] PROFILE IDENTIFIER

  Replace a placement (name or one-based index) with equivalent inline plates.

  Resolved plate values and order, hence observation identity, are unchanged; the
  placement stops following later edits to the preset.

Options:
  --dry-run   Print proposed TOML diff; write nothing.
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.
```

## `pyrite filter set`

```text
Usage: pyrite filter set [OPTIONS] NAME

  Update a user definition; future resolutions receive its new values.

Options:
  --description TEXT
  --material TEXT
  --thickness-mm FLOAT
  --size-mm <FLOAT FLOAT>...
  --distance-mm FLOAT
  --polar-deg FLOAT
  --azimuth-deg FLOAT
  --roll-deg FLOAT
  --offset-mm <FLOAT FLOAT>...
  --dry-run
  -h, --help                    Show this message and exit.
```

## `pyrite filter show`

```text
Usage: pyrite filter show [OPTIONS] NAME

  Inspect one filter definition and its referencing profile placements.

Options:
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.
```
